dogecoin.text: After Dogecoin exploded, meme season officially began. SHIBA INU came in hot with a “DOGE killer” narrative. Then came FLOKI, PEPE, and a hundred more.

It didn’t make sense. 
And that’s exactly why it worked. DOGE wasn’t about fundamentals - it was pure internet energy. 
A meme with a market cap bigger than real companies.
